spans.text: During the emotion regulation task in the fMRI scanner subjects saw 60 pictures of negative or neutral content taken from the International Affective Picture System (IAPS, Lang et al., 2008 ).

description.value: Participants viewed negative or neutral IAPS pictures and either permitted their emotions or regulated them using one of four strategies.

spans.text: ‘Regulate Negative’

description.value: Participants viewed negative IAPS pictures for 8 seconds and were required to regulate their emotions using the strategy assigned to their group: Detachment, Reinterpretation, Expressive Suppression, or Distraction.

spans.text: ‘Permit Negative’

description.value: Participants viewed negative IAPS pictures for 8 seconds and were instructed to look directly at the picture and permit feeling their emotions, without applying a regulation strategy.

spans.text: ‘Permit Neutral’

description.value: Participants viewed neutral IAPS pictures for 8 seconds and were instructed to look directly at the picture and permit feeling their emotions.

spans.text: During the emotion regulation task in the fMRI scanner subjects saw 60 pictures of negative or neutral content taken from the International Affective Picture System (IAPS, Lang et al., 2008 ).
All subjects were instructed for all conditions to look at the picture.

instructions.value: Participants viewed negative or neutral IAPS pictures. For Permit Neutral and Permit Negative they were instructed to look directly at the picture and permit feeling their emotions. For Regulate Negative they used one assigned strategy: take the position of a noninvolved observer, reinterpret the picture so it no longer elicited a negative response, keep the face still so observers could not detect subjective experience, or silently rehearse a learned 9-digit number.
